scripts.heroku:build: if [ "$HEROKU_APP_TYPE" = "web" ]; then cd apps/web && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build; else cd apps/api && bun install --frozen-lockfile; fi
scripts.heroku:release: if [ "$HEROKU_APP_TYPE" = "web" ]; then echo "No release step for web app."; else cd apps/api && bun run db:migrate; fi
scripts.heroku:start: if [ "$HEROKU_APP_TYPE" = "web" ]; then cd apps/web && bun run start; else cd apps/api && bun run start; fi
